traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Cannaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire; veins pinnate; blades linear, lanceolate or oblanceolate; leaf rosettes none; plants hermaphrodite; ovary inferior; stems herbaceous; flowers in spikes or in panicles; flowers asymmetric; perianth sepals and petals or tepals; fruit capsule; parts of each whorl 3; stamens 1; carpels 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 50, family Cannaceae: phyllotaxis pattern distichous, usually; read as {"distichous": "usually"}.

traits.life_span.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 248, 249, 252, family Cannaceae: life span perennial; read as "perennial".

traits.rhizome_habit.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 255, 256, family Cannaceae: rhizome habit short_creeping, starchy (Canna edulis), usually. Read together as {"short_creeping": "usually"}.

traits.axis_growth.note: Simpson, Plant Systematics (2019) p. 248, 249, 252, family Cannaceae: axis growth sympodial; read as "sympodial".
